title: A Neutron Star Hidden Inside a Black Hole
summary: We investigate dark matter admixed neutron stars in which the neutron star coexists with an anisotropic dark matter halo described by the Einasto density profile, a model recently shown to produce regular, singularity-free black hole solutions~[Phys. Rev. D \textbf{113}, 043011 (2026)]. Solving the modified Tolman--Oppenheimer--Volkoff equations with two different equations of state (BSk19 and SLy4), we find that the dark matter halo significantly alters the neutron star structure.
